comment: Furniture sprite manifest for the layered office (shell + sprites). Types match office_plan.json furniture entries. Sprites are generated once as isolated isometric assets on transparent backgrounds (baked soft under-shadow, light from upper-left, cool ambient + warm accent), placed by the plan at exact anchors, z-sorted by screen-y. `scale` = sprite width in grid units per 1.0 of the furniture block's w.
style_lock: stylized 3D isometric game asset, 2:1 isometric angle matching a diamond floor grid, single object on transparent background, soft baked drop shadow under the object, lit from upper-left, cool blue ambient with warm amber accent, cinematic teal-and-amber grade, high detail, no text, no watermark
